stories.title: North Clwyd Animal Rescue closes for a week after puppies fall ill
stories.summary: North Clwyd Animal Rescue is to close for a week as a precaution, after a litter of puppies from the Mostyn area became unwell. stories.title: Shotton railway station to get new Transport for Wales Help Point
stories.summary: Shotton railway station is to get a new Help Point, Transport for Wales has confirmed. It is one of 48 stations across Wales sharing in a £1 million investment to install the devices, which connect passengers directly to a Customer Information Controller at the press of a button. stories.title: Dough & Doppio’s famous focaccia is coming to Chester, here’s what we know
stories.summary: Dough & Doppio, the Italian deli known for its focaccia sandwiches, is opening a second shop in Chester. The business confirmed the news on its Facebook page, saying it had been planning the move for months. Its original site is on New Chester Road in Bromborough, which opened in 2024. stories.title: Motorists have been warned to avoid Liverpool Road in Buckley after reports of flooding
stories.summary: Motorists have been warned to avoid Liverpool Road in Buckley after reports of flooding. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team issued the warning on Facebook at 5.21am. stories.title: Flint councillor warns of HMO “unwelcome precedent” as officers recommend approval
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council officers have recommended approval for a plan to turn a three-bedroom house in Flint into a four-person house in multiple occupation, known as an HMO.
